name: CHAI
summary: Established mobile-app platform for AI conversation with a free download and in-app subscriptions. Fictional adult-oriented text is allowed under the EULA; explicit image/video generation is not.
ranking_rationale: Store distribution is verifiable (App Store listing) and the EULA documents a limited adult-text policy. A numeric free quota, image generation, voice, and any memory specification were not verifiable, and CHAI WEB is still listed as coming soon — it ranks low on documented feature completeness, not on popularity.
